arxiv-2209-10686.creator: Yingjie Zhu (朱英杰), Judit Szente, Enrico Landi
arxiv-2209-10686.description: Abstract The temperatures of the heavy ions ( T i T_{i} ) in the solar corona provide critical information about the heating mechanism of the million-degree corona. However, the measurement of T i T_{i} is usually challenging due to the nonthermal motion, instrumental limitations, and the optically thin nature of the coronal emissions.

arxiv-2401-09787.title: Querying Easily Flip-flopped Samples for Deep Active Learning
arxiv-2401-09787.creator: Seong Jin Cho, Gwangsu Kim, Junghyun Lee, Jinwoo Shin, Chang D. Yoo
arxiv-2401-09787.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Seong Jin Cho, Gwangsu Kim, Junghyun Lee, Jinwoo Shin, Chang D. Yoo. Active learning, a paradigm within machine learning, aims to select and query unlabeled data to enhance model performance strategically. A crucial selection strategy leverages the model’s predictive uncertainty, reflecting the informativeness of a data point. While the sample’s distance to the decision boundary intuitively measures predictive uncertainty, its computation becomes intractable for complex decision boundaries formed in multiclass classification tasks.

arxiv-2410-11010.creator: Sharief Saleh 1, Musa Furkan Keskin 1, Basuki Priyanto 2, Martin Beale 2
arxiv-2410-11010.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sharief Saleh 1, Musa Furkan Keskin 1, Basuki Priyanto 2, Martin Beale 2. 6G networks aim to enable applications like autonomous driving by providing complementary localization services through key technologies such as non-terrestrial networks (NTNs) with low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites and reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS). Prior research in 6G localization using single LEO, multi-LEO, and multi-LEO multi-RIS setups has limitations: single LEO lacks the required accuracy, while multi-LEO/RIS setups demand many visible satellites and RISs, which is not always feasible in practice.

arxiv-2509-03708.title: Twisted quantum doubles are sign problem-free
arxiv-2509-03708.creator: Leyna Shackleton
arxiv-2509-03708.description: Abstract The sign problem is one of the central obstacles to efficiently simulating quantum many-body systems. It is commonly believed that some phases of matter, such as the double semion model, have an intrinsic sign problem and can never be realized in a local sign problem-free Hamiltonian due to the non-positivity of the wavefunction.

pmc-11465086.title: Deciphering the role of endothelial granulocyte macrophage-CSF in chronic inflammation associated with HIV
pmc-11465086.creator: Soumya Panigrahi, Elizabeth Mayne, Susan Louw, Nicholas T Funderburg, Archeesha Chakraborty, Jeffrey M Jacobson, Stephen M Carpenter, Michael M Lederman, Michael L Freeman, Scott F Sieg
pmc-11465086.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). SummaryPeople with HIV (PWH) experience endothelial dysfunction (ED) that is aggravated by chronic inflammation and microbial translocation across a damaged gut barrier. Although this paradigm is well-described, downstream pathways that terminate in endothelial dysfunction are only partially understood. This study found increased expression of granulocyte macrophage colony stimulating factor (GM-CSF), toll-like receptor-4 (TLR4), and myeloperoxidase in the aortic endothelium of PWH compared to those without HIV. Bacteria-derived lipopolysaccharide (LPS) heightened glucose uptake and induced GM-CSF expression in primary human endothelial cells.

pmc-11641114.title: The DLEU2–miR-15a–16-1 Cluster Is a Determinant of Bone Microarchitecture and Strength in Postmenopausal Women and Mice
pmc-11641114.creator: Sjur Reppe, Janne Elin Reseland, Vid Prijatelj, Michael Prediger, Liebert Parreiras Nogueira, Tor Paaske Utheim, Fernando Rivadeneira, Kaare M Gautvik, Harish Kumar Datta, Gail B Mahady
pmc-11641114.description: This study explores how select microRNAs (miRNAs) influence bone structure in humans and in transgenic mice. In trabecular bone biopsies from 84 postmenopausal women (healthy, osteopenic, and osteoporotic), we demonstrate that DLEU2 (deleted in lymphocytic leukemia 2)-encoded miR-15a-5p is strongly positively associated with bone mineral density (BMD) at different skeletal sites.

pmc-12547604.title: In Silico Exploration of the Endocrine-Disrupting Potential of Phthalate Esters through Structural Interaction with the Human Androgen Receptor
pmc-12547604.creator: Ariana Alarco-Cusi, Andrea Apaza-Chaña, Margot Paco-Chipana, Angela Emperatriz Centeno Lopez, Fabrizio Johnson-Corrales, Karel Mena-Ulecia, Miguel Chavez-Fumagalli, Haruna Luz Barazorda-Ccahuana
pmc-12547604.description: Phthalate esters are ubiquitous environmental pollutants with a well-documented potential to disrupt steroid hormone signaling, particularly through interactions with the human androgen receptor (hAR). This study used a structure-based virtual screening approach to evaluate phthalates using testosterone as the reference ligand. Three independent molecular docking platforms were used to assess binding affinity and pose consistency.
